title: AnthropicAPIOptions
description: Native Anthropic Messages API request options used by Captain's API runtime.

model.title: Model
model.description: Anthropic model identifier used to complete the request.

max_tokens.title: Maximum output tokens
max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens generated before stopping, including extended-thinking tokens.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Alternating user and assistant messages sent to the Messages API.

system.title: System prompt
system.description: System instruction blocks supplied outside the message list.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Sampling temperature between zero and one.

output_config.title: Output configuration
output_config.description: Structured-output format and adaptive-thinking effort configuration.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Native Anthropic tool definitions derived from Captain caller tools.

x-captain-option.note: Captain derives native tool definitions from runtime Config.Tools and the Spec tool policy.

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: Whether the Messages API returns server-sent streaming events.

x-captain-option.note: Captain selects the SDK streaming method for ExecuteStream.

container.title: Container
container.description: Container identifier reused across Messages API requests.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose Anthropic container reuse.

inference_geo.title: Inference geography
inference_geo.description: Geographic region requested for inference processing.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not set a per-request inference geography.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Number of highest-probability tokens retained during sampling.

x-captain-option.note: Captain has no native top-k Spec field.

top_p.title: Top P
top_p.description: Cumulative probability mass retained during nucleus sampling.

x-captain-option.note: Captain has no native top-p Spec field.

cache_control.title: Cache control
cache_control.description: Top-level prompt-cache marker applied to the final cacheable block.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not set Anthropic top-level cache control.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Request metadata, including the optional user identifier.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not forward per-request Anthropic metadata.

service_tier.title: Service tier
service_tier.description: Capacity tier used to serve the request.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not select an Anthropic service tier.

stop_sequences.title: Stop sequences
stop_sequences.description: Text sequences that stop generation when encountered.

x-captain-option.note: Captain has no stop-sequence Spec field.

tool_choice.title: Tool choice
tool_choice.description: Policy controlling whether and which native tool Claude should call.

x-captain-option.note: Captain supplies tool definitions but does not set Anthropic tool_choice.
